title: Cracked hob (determinative)
summary: Cracked induction surface on a 4-year-old hob. Fixed-outcome fault: code A regardless of age or cost ratio. No photo obtainable, so confidence is capped.
expected: assess_repair_vs_replace returns code A with determinative true. Age (4.2y, inside the 7-year line) and cost ratio (42%, well inside the 70% boundary) both point to repair and must not move the code. No photo can be obtained, so confidence is 0.6 or below with the ambiguity named in evidence_gaps. Replacement still routes through engineer confirmation before booking; at GBP 389 it is under the PM threshold, so no PM approval is sought.

issue.description: Resident reports a crack in the hob surface - a dark line across the front-right zone that appeared suddenly. Hob has not been used since.

resident_persona.name: Leila Haddad
resident_persona.ground_truth: A pan of cold water boiled over onto the hot front-right zone two days ago and there was a sharp cracking noise. There is now a thin dark line roughly 10cm long across that zone. It is a genuine crack, though she cannot be certain of that herself - she cannot tell whether her fingernail catches in it or whether she is feeling the edge of a scorch mark. She has not used the hob since and has switched it off at the wall.
resident_persona.behaviour: Careful and cooperative. Describes what she can see clearly and accurately. Will say plainly that she cannot tell a crack from a heat mark when asked. IMPORTANT: she cannot send a photograph under any circumstances - she uses a basic handset with no camera and has no other device. If asked for a photo she says so directly and offers to describe it instead. She will not invent certainty she does not have.
